validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="sid"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a"><onentry><send event="t" id="s1" idlocation="sid" delay="1s"/><cancel sendid="s1" sendidexpr="sid"/></onentry><transition event="t" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: send ID cannot use both `id` and `idlocation`
notes: each `<send>` property (event, target, type, delay, and the send ID as `id` or `idlocation`) has one literal and one computed form; supplying both is ambiguous
`<cancel>` identifies exactly one delayed `<send>` to cancel, either literally (`sendid`) or computed (`sendidexpr`)
diagnostics.help: keep exactly one send identifier source
